# Make My QR Code

> Make My QR Code is a free online QR code generator. It creates static,
> non-expiring QR codes with no watermark and no scan limit. All QR codes are
> free for personal and commercial use.

Make My QR Code is a browser-based tool at https://makemyqrcode.com/. You pick a
QR content type (URL, text, email, phone, SMS, vCard, Wi-Fi, location, event, crypto), customise the colours, and download a high-resolution PNG or SVG.
Because the codes are static, they keep working for as long as the encoded
destination exists — there is no subscription and nothing to renew.

## Core pages

- [QR code generator](https://makemyqrcode.com/): Create a free, non-expiring QR code online and download it as a PNG or SVG.
- [About Make My QR Code](https://makemyqrcode.com/about-qr-code-generator.html): What the tool does, how it stays free, and answers to 11 common questions about QR codes, expiry, formats and commercial use.
- [Types of QR codes](https://makemyqrcode.com/category-qr-code-types.html): The QR code content types you can generate, with use cases.
- [Blog](https://makemyqrcode.com/blog.html): Guides and marketing advice for using QR codes in a business.

## Comparisons

- [Free QR code generators compared](https://makemyqrcode.com/compare-qr-code-generators.html): An honest side-by-side of Make My QR Code, QRCode Monkey, QR Code Generator (Bitly) and Bitly, including where each one is the better choice.

## Key facts

- QR codes generated at Make My QR Code are static and permanent: they do not expire and have no scan limit.
- No account, email address or payment details are required to download.
- Free for commercial use, with no watermark on the downloaded image.
- Optional logo upload, six body styles and colour presets are included at no cost.
- Download formats: high-resolution PNG and SVG. PDF and EPS are not offered.
- The codes contain the data directly, so they cannot be edited after printing or downloading. Changing the destination means generating a new code.
- Scan analytics and dynamic redirects are not offered; competitors such as QR Code Generator and Bitly provide those as paid features.
